raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.9.0"
  pytest_k: |-
    not (
      test_clean_roundtrip
      or test_codegen_clean_matcher_classes
      or test_codegen_clean_return_types
      or test_codegen_clean_visitor_functions
      or test_codemod_formatter_error_input
      or test_gen_cache_0
      or test_simple_class_types_0
      or test_transform_roundtrip
      or test_with_empty_cache
    )

package:
  name: libcst
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/l/libcst/libcst-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 087b58a9afe076bb08e2d726478e1f16cb928d67ffa9092817e033c335de522a
  patches:
    - 0001-Add-headerpad_max_install_names-to-linker-arguments.patch

build:
  number: 1
  script:
    env:
      SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION: ${{ version }}
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
      CARGO: cargo-auditable-wrapper.${{ "bat" if win else "sh" }}
    content:
      - if: win
        then:
          - copy "%RECIPE_DIR%\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat" "%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\"
        else:
          - cp "${RECIPE_DIR}/cargo-auditable-wrapper.sh" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/"
          - chmod 755 "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper.sh"
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check
      - cd native/libcst
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format=yaml --output=THIRDPARTY.yml

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - cargo-auditable
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - setuptools
        - setuptools-rust
        - setuptools-scm
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - setuptools-rust
    - setuptools-scm
  run:
    - python
    - if: match(python, ">=3.14")
      then:
        - pyyaml >=6.0.3
    - if: match(python, "3.13.*")
      then:
        - pyyaml-ft >=8.0.0
    - if: match(python, "<3.13")
      then:
        - pyyaml >=5.2

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - libcst
        - libcst._nodes
        - libcst._nodes.tests
        - libcst._parser
        - libcst._parser.conversions
        - libcst._parser.parso
        - libcst._parser.parso.pgen2
        - libcst._parser.parso.python
        - libcst._parser.parso.tests
        - libcst._parser.tests
        - libcst._parser.types
        - libcst._parser.types.tests
        - libcst.codegen
        - libcst.codegen.tests
        - libcst.codemod
        - libcst.codemod.commands
        - libcst.codemod.commands.tests
        - libcst.codemod.tests
        - libcst.codemod.visitors
        - libcst.codemod.visitors.tests
        - libcst.helpers
        - libcst.helpers.tests
        - libcst.matchers
        - libcst.matchers.tests
        - libcst.metadata
        - libcst.metadata.tests
        - libcst.testing
        - libcst.tests
  - requirements:
      run:
        - hypothesis
        - hypothesmith
        - pytest-cov
    script:
      - coverage run --source=libcst --branch -m pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes --pyargs libcst -k "${{ pytest_k | replace('\n', ' ') }}"
      - coverage report --show-missing --skip-covered --fail-under=88

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - native/libcst/THIRDPARTY.yml
  summary: A concrete syntax tree with AST-like properties for Python 3.0 through 3.15 programs.
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/libcst
  repository: https://github.com/Instagram/LibCST
  documentation: https://libcst.readthedocs.io
